name: Lykaois
source:
Lykaois is A 18+ VN about self discovery, trust, and loyalty. Can you relate to the events that take place on this journey? If not can you sympathize? 

Come take an adventure on self discovery, love, loyalty, and trust as you, a lone survivor of earth, are constantly push beyond your limits both physically and emotionally. After the third world war has completely ravaged and wiped out everything on earth, you take on the role of looking for any survivors like yourself. After searching for so long, you come across a lone being after they saved your life. But not all is what it seems to be with them as well as you. First and foremost they're not even human, then they tell you they've come to take you home. Back home to Lycania.

What does this mean? You're a native of planet earth. Right? Do you trust this being and their words? Can you depend on them to help find the answers you seek? Grab hold of the path fate has lined up for you and walk this path in the shoes of Fenris in self discovery as you're constantly push to your limits. Have hope, have faith and may you run free with the wolves.

[From [url=https://demonicalpha.itch.io/lykaois]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Lykaois是一位18岁以上的越南人，注重自我发现、信任和忠诚。你能理解这次旅程中发生的事件吗？如果不是你能同情吗？

来一场关于自我发现、爱、忠诚和信任的冒险吧，作为地球上孤独的幸存者，不断突破身体和情感的极限。在第三次世界大战彻底蹂躏并消灭了地球上的一切之后，你将扮演寻找像你一样的幸存者的角色。经过这么长时间的寻找，在他们救了你的命之后，你遇到了一个孤独的人。但他们和你的情况并非都是如此。首先，他们甚至不是人类，然后他们告诉你他们是来带你回家的。回到利卡尼亚的家。

这意味着什么？你是地球人。正确的？你相信这个存在和他们的话吗？你可以依靠他们来帮助你找到所需的答案吗？抓住命运为你安排的道路，并以芬里斯的立场走在自我发现的道路上，不断挑战自己的极限。抱有希望，抱有信心，愿你能与狼群一起自由奔跑。

[来自[url=https://demonicalpha.itch.io/lykaois]Itch.io[/url]]
